children: The slump in Australia house prices is now likely to extend to around 10% from peak to trough, with the combined fall in capital cities extending to 11%, led by a 13% drop in Sydney, says Shane Oliver, chief economist at AMP. Prices aren't expected to bottom until around the second quarter next year and should start a modest recovery in 2027-28 as the RBA starts to shift to interest rate cuts, he adds. The home price slump will weigh on economic growth, but is not significant enough yet to change the direction of interest rates, he says. (james.glynn@wsj.com; X @JamesGlynnWSJ)
